A '''Ragunna Terminal''' is a lantern-shaped [[Terminal]]. In [[Ragunna]], Reserved Terminals are a rare sight, most Ragunnesi only being allowed to use Common Terminals.

Owning a private Terminal requires registration at [[Order of the Deep|The Order]].
